name: DUOMASK
author: strings-agent
description: MEDIUM-HARD. Intersection of two regular expressions. Clue is 'RE1 RE2' (space separated, the patterns never contain spaces). Both patterns are built token-by-token from a hidden witness string w over {a,b} (length 5-8) using tokens that all match the corresponding character - a literal, '.', '[ab]', '(a|b)', 'x+', 'x?' - plus occasional nullable 'x*' fillers, so at least one common string is guaranteed. Solution: ANY string of length 1..16 that re.fullmatch-es both patterns. Scorer is two fullmatches plus a length guard (~110 chars); patterns have no nested quantifiers so backtracking is bounded. Solve: breadth-first enumeration of {a,b}* by length, stopping at the first string matching both, ~1-3 ms. Discovery path: the clue is obviously regex-shaped, so the real hurdles are (1) realising BOTH patterns must match, not either, and (2) fullmatch vs search anchoring - a team that uses re.search or satisfies only the first pattern scores 0 on most items but not all, which is the gradient. At least two non-nullable tokens per pattern guarantee the empty string never scores.
